{{Attr|Aggro}} (Wave 5 only) }} ==Description== The '''Corrupted Wraith''' was a tanky enemy that appeared in [[Nil Zone]] as part of the [[Halloween 2025 Live Events]] and [[Halloween 2026 Live Events]]. It can currently only be accessed through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode if the player has its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]. It had higher health than the [[Nulling]]s that appeared before it, but is slightly slower to make up for its health. On some waves, it could spawn with all sorts of attributes. ==Appearance== The '''Corrupted Wraith''' has pitch-black skin and its head is completely faceless. It has multiple holes in its body, revealing the corruption inside it. It wears a metal chestplate and shoulder-pads with purple tints. On its right arm, it wears a grey armband with a blade attached to it, though it never uses it. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Nil Zone]] is listed instead. *While initially only spawn in as a single enemy per path, they do spawn in larger numbers as waves progress, meaning that AOE towers can excel at defeating it. **Explosive towers like the [[Rocketeer]] or [[Mortar]] can be used, however, do note that as the waves progress, enemies with immunity to their damage will appear making them weaker. **Other forms of AOE like debuff from the [[Toxic Gunner]] or [[Pyromancer]], or towers with alternate means of damaging multiple enemies at once like the [[Electroshocker]] and [[Archer]] can be useful. *Being the debuting enemy, it is not particularly difficult to deal with, meaning even single target towers like the [[Engineer]], [[Golden Soldier]] or [[Ace Pilot]] can deal with them. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V2.1.0GenericThumbnail6.png|'''Corrupted Wraith''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} CorruptedWraithWalk.gif|Walking animation (4 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseCorruptedWraith.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (4 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} CorruptedWraithIconIG.png|'''Corrupted Wraith''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Corrupted Wraith''' is the corrupted version of the [[Hex Wraith]] from the [[Hexscape Event]]. *The '''Corrupted Wraith''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''4 October 2025''' -
